era: 1872 年生于加尔各答婆罗门家庭，五岁起随兄赴英受教十四年（曼彻斯特、伦敦圣保罗学校、剑桥国王学院），精通希腊拉丁与数种欧洲语文而几乎不识母语——1893 年回国入巴罗达土邦任职，从行政官到大学院教授，自学梵文与印度经典——1905 年孟加拉分治后投身民族运动，先密谋武装起义，后公开办《向母亲致敬》（Bande Mataram）成为第一个公开要求完全独立（purna swaraj）的印度政治家——1907 年因煽动罪被诉而获释，1908 年因阿利普尔密谋案入狱一年，狱中修瑜伽而得'无处不在的克里希那、无物不梵'的灵性觉醒——1909 年无罪开释后发表著名的乌塔帕拉演说，短暂复办《业瑜伽》（Karmayogin）与《法》（Dharma）——1910 年'奉上界之命'悄然赴法属本地治里，此后四十年不再公开介入政治——1914-1921 年与法国人格力埃（Paul Richard）创办哲学月刊《阿雅亚》（Arya），连载产出《神圣人生论》《瑜伽综合论》《吠陀的秘密》《薄伽梵歌论》《人类统一的理想》等全部主要著作——1926 年'悉地日'宣布超心（Overmind）降入物理意识后退隐，此后仅在每年四个达善日露面，修道院事务交密那·阿尔法萨（'母亲'）主持——1950 年逝世于本地治里——身后'整体瑜伽'经萨特普雷姆续写《母亲的议程》传入欧美，奥罗维尔实验城成为其'人类统一'理想的制度遗存
era_en: Born 1872 in Calcutta into a Brahmin family, sent to England at five and schooled there for fourteen years (Manchester, St. Paul's School London, King's College Cambridge)—master of Greek, Latin and several European languages yet almost ignorant of his mother tongue—returned in 1893 to serve in the Baroda state, from administrator to college professor, teaching himself Sanskrit and the Indian classics—after the 1905 Partition of Bengal threw himself into the national movement: secret preparation for armed insurrection first, then public journalism through Bande Mataram, becoming the first Indian politician to demand complete independence (purna swaraj) openly—prosecuted for sedition in 1907 and acquitted, imprisoned in 1908 for a year in the Alipore conspiracy case, where he practiced yoga and had the realization of 'Krishna everywhere, the Divine in everything'—released in May 1909, delivered the famous Uttarpara speech, briefly ran the weeklies Karmayogin and Dharma—in April 1910, 'by a command from above,' quietly went to French Pondicherry and for the next forty years took no public part in politics—founded the philosophical monthly Arya in 1914 with the Frenchman Paul Richard, serializing the works that became his books: The Life Divine, The Synthesis of Yoga, The Secret of the Veda, Essays on the Gita, The Ideal of Human Unity—on 'Siddhi Day' 1926 announced the descent of the Overmind into the physical and withdrew, seen only on four darshan days a year, entrusting the ashram to Mirra Alfassa ('the Mother')—died in Pondicherry in 1950—after his death Integral Yoga passed to Europe and America through Satprem's The Agenda of the Mother, and the experimental city of Auroville stands as the institutional legacy of his 'ideal of human unity'
school: 整体瑜伽（Purna Yoga）的创立者（个体解放之外更求世界转化的灵性进路）/ '意识演化'哲学的立法者（精神内卷—物质—生命—心智—超心智的演化总纲）/ 民族运动'极端派'的理论家（完全独立的第一个公开主张者）/ 印度文明精神解释的复兴者（《吠陀的秘密》《薄伽梵歌论》的经典重释者）/ 三重转化与超心智降临学说的提出者
historical_significance: 奥罗宾多·高士（1872-1950），印度革命家、哲学家、瑜伽行者与诗人，二十世纪最有体系的印度精神思想家。他的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，'意识演化'总纲的立法：把吠陀的'梵'与达尔文的'演化'焊接成一套完整宇宙论——精神'内卷'入物质，意识经物质、生命、心智逐层重新涌现，而人类心智只是过渡阶段，演化的下一站是'超心智'（Supermind）——灵性传统向后看黄金时代、向上看来世解脱，他向前看：地球上将有意识的新种。其二，整体瑜伽的开创：传统四道（智、爱、业、王）皆求个体解脱出世界，他把四道综合并加上第五要素——神圣意识降入身体与物质生活，目标是转化地上的生命而非逃离它。其三，三重转化方法：心灵转化（发现内在灵魂）、灵性转化（向上层意识开敞）、超心智转化（下降改写心智生命身体的本性）——一条有次第、可执行的世界转化工艺。其四，民族运动的理论突破：第一个公开要求完全独立、把民族主义表述为'神的工'、乌塔帕拉演说把狱中觉醒化为'一切皆是梵'的政治神学——四十年政治生涯与四十年隐修在同一人身上衔接，革命者与先知同体。其五，文本建制：《神圣人生论》《瑜伽综合论》《人类循环论》以及两万四千行的史诗《莎维德丽》构成一个自足的思想体系，经阿罗频多修道院与奥罗维尔两大制度载体持续运作至今。代价与极限：超心智降临被批评为不可证伪的形上学许诺（他本人承认第三重转化'或需数世纪'）；生平被后世灵性营销反复简化，双面人生的革命史实层常被遮蔽；'民族主义即宗教'的表述在其身后被各方挪用。
historical_significance_en: Aurobindo Ghose (1872-1950), Indian revolutionary, philosopher, yogi and poet, was the most systematic Indian spiritual thinker of the twentieth century. Five achievements anchor his standing. First, the legislation of 'the evolution of consciousness': welding the Vedic Brahman onto Darwinian evolution into a complete cosmology—Spirit 'involutes' into matter, consciousness re-emerges through matter, life and mind, human mind is only a transitional stage, and evolution's next station is the 'Supermind'—where spiritual traditions looked back to a golden age or upward to otherworldly liberation, he looked forward: a new species of consciousness on this earth. Second, the founding of Integral Yoga: the traditional four paths (jnana, bhakti, karma, raja) all seek individual liberation out of the world; he synthesized them and added a fifth element—the descent of divine consciousness into the body and material life, aiming at transforming life on earth, not fleeing it. Third, the method of the triple transformation: psychic (the discovery of the inner soul), spiritual (opening to the higher planes), supramental (the descent that rewrites mind, life and body)—a staged, executable craft of world-transformation. Fourth, the theoretical breakthrough in the national movement: the first public demand for complete independence, nationalism stated as 'the work of God,' the Uttarpara speech turning the prison realization into the political theology of 'all is Brahman'—four decades of politics and four decades of seclusion joined in one man, revolutionary and seer in a single body. Fifth, textual institution-building: The Life Divine, The Synthesis of Yoga, The Human Cycle, and the 24,000-line epic Savitri form a self-standing system, carried to this day by two institutions, the Sri Aurobindo Ashram and Auroville. Costs and limits: the supramental descent is criticized as an unfalsifiable metaphysical promise (he himself conceded the third transformation 'might take centuries'); his life is repeatedly flattened by later spiritual marketing, the revolutionary half of his double life often occluded; and 'nationalism as religion' has been appropriated by many hands since.
unique_thinking: 他思维方式的底色是'演化即灵性、灵性即工程：神性不是彼岸而是尚未抵达的此岸前方——思想的任务不是描述已成的世界而是为未成的世界开路'。六个标志性动作。其一，'内卷—演化双程法'——任何'突现的新事物'都不是无中生有：在物质中沉睡的必在演化中觉醒，向下内卷多深、向上涌现就有多远的对应阶梯。其二，'过渡存在定位法'——把'当前状态'重新定义为'中间阶段'：人不完备不是缺陷而是工件，判断任何现状先问'它处在哪个过程上'。其三，'三重转化分程法'——把不可企及的大目标拆成三个递进可执行的层级，每层有自己的入口、障碍与完成判据，逐层打通。其四，'整体统摄法'——拒绝把任一真实面向（知识、爱、行动、身体）当成全部：四道综合、身心智灵四层并修，综合不是并列而是让每一道在下一次转化中各就其位。其五，'降入法'——一切高级状态的检验不在其上的清晰而在其下的落地：意识必须降入最稠密的物质层才算完成，'高而未降'只是体验不是成就。其六，'人类统一收束法'——个体的完满与整体的统一是同一件事的两面，个人修行最终必须收束为世界性建制（修道院、奥罗维尔）。代价与极限：体系高度依赖'内卷'这个形上学前提，前提若不成立则整套演化阶梯悬空；'超心智'词汇的可操作性在弟子传承中递减；转化时间表（数世纪）使体系在实践中依赖象征性建制而非可验证成果。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking: evolution is spirituality and spirituality is engineering—the Divine is not beyond but ahead, in a not-yet-arrived region of this world; thought's task is not to describe a finished world but to open the road for an unfinished one. Six signature moves. First, the involution-evolution double pass—nothing genuinely new arises from nothing: what sleeps in matter must waken in evolution; the depth of the downward involution sets the length of the upward ladder. Second, transitional-being positioning—redefine 'the current state' as 'an intermediate stage': human incompleteness is not a defect but a work in progress; of any present condition first ask 'at what point in which process does it stand.' Third, the staged triple transformation—break an unreachable great goal into three ascending executable levels, each with its own entrance, obstacle and completion test, cleared level by level. Fourth, integral synthesis—refuse to make any real facet (knowledge, love, action, body) the whole: synthesize the four paths, cultivate body, life, mind and spirit together; synthesis is not juxtaposition but giving each path its station in the next transformation. Fifth, the descent test—the proof of any higher state lies not in its clarity above but in its landing below: consciousness must descend into the densest material layer to count as achieved; 'high but not descended' is experience, not attainment. Sixth, human-unity closure—the perfection of the individual and the unity of the whole are two faces of one thing; personal practice must finally close into world-institutions (the ashram, Auroville). Costs and limits: the whole ladder hangs on the metaphysical premise of involution—without it the stages float; the operationality of 'supramental' vocabulary thins down the line of successors; and a timetable of centuries leaves the system resting on symbolic institutions rather than verifiable results.

modes.domain_zh: 《神圣人生论》的核心立法。传统印度思想的问题是把解脱指向'向上出离'（moksha，逃出轮回），达尔文主义的问题是只有向上的盲目攀升而没有目的。奥罗宾多的解法是补上向下那一半：神圣（存在—意识—妙乐，Satchidananda）先'内卷'——逐层隐没入心智、生命、物质，直至在物质中几乎全然遗忘自己；演化就是这一沉入的倒放——意识从物质中先浮现生命、再浮现心智。这一立法立即产生两个后果。其一，演化有方向也有潜能位阶：物质里沉睡着生命，生命里沉睡着心智，心智里沉睡着超心智——'人类心智是过渡阶段'由此从口号变成结构位置。其二，'创新'被重新定义：凡在演化中涌现的，必是先已内卷的——新事物是旧沉睡物的觉醒，不是无中生有。这使他能够同时接受达尔文的事实与超越达尔文的解释：演化的机制可以是变异选择，而演化的方向与每一站'恰好涌现'的潜能需要内卷的存根来解释。代价与极限：内卷是不可观察的形上学前提，整座阶梯悬在它上面——拿掉它，'心智里沉睡超心智'就只是断言；且双程结构易被滥用为'一切皆注定涌现'的目的论，从而忽视演化中的灭绝、倒退与偶然——奥罗宾多承认阻力（'黑暗力量'），但体系内没有给偶然演化留下真正位置。
modes.domain_en: The core legislation of The Life Divine. Traditional Indian thought aims liberation 'upward and out' (moksha, escape from the cycle); Darwinism has blind ascent but no aim. Aurobindo's solution is to supply the downward half: the Divine (Satchidananda—Existence-Consciousness-Bliss) first 'involutes'—hiding itself layer by layer in mind, life and matter until in matter it has all but forgotten itself; evolution is that plunge played in reverse—consciousness surfacing from matter first as life, then as mind. Two consequences follow at once. First, evolution has a direction and a hierarchy of potential: life sleeps in matter, mind sleeps in life, Supermind sleeps in mind—'human mind is a transitional stage' thus becomes a structural position, not a slogan. Second, 'novelty' is redefined: whatever emerges in evolution was first involuted—the new is the awakening of an old sleeper, not creatio ex nihilo. This lets him accept Darwin's facts while exceeding Darwin's explanation: the mechanism may be variation and selection, but the direction of evolution and the potentials that surface 'just in time' at each station demand involutionary deposits to account for them. Costs and limits: involution is an unobservable metaphysical premise on which the whole ladder hangs—remove it and 'Supermind sleeps in mind' is mere assertion; and the double-pass tempts abuse into 'everything is destined to emerge,' ignoring extinction, regression and chance in evolution—Aurobindo admits resistance ('dark forces') but gives real contingency no true place in the system.

modes.definition_en: Evolutionary-ontology methodology/involution downward and evolution upward are one pass played in reverse: life sleeps in matter, mind in life, Supermind in mind—the new is the awakening of an old sleeper, and the depth of involution sets the length of the emergence ladder

key_concepts: 内卷 involution（神圣逐层隐没入心智、生命、物质的下行程）
演化 evolution（意识自物质逐层涌现的上升程——内卷的倒放）
潜能位阶 the hierarchy of potential（每一层沉睡着上一层的可能性）

modes.key_quote_zh: 心智不是演化的最后一级——在它之上还有更高的意识等着涌现：内卷入物质者，必自物质中涌现。
modes.key_quote_en: Mind is not the last grade of evolution—above it waits a higher consciousness yet to emerge: what was involuted into matter must emerge out of matter.
process_zh: 对'突现的新事物'提问：它真的是无中生有，还是某种已在场之物的觉醒？——追认其'内卷存根'（哪些潜能早已沉睡在场）
重建双程阶梯：把当前状态放回下行与上行两个方向中——它由哪些层隐没而来，又将向哪些层涌现而去
推演下一站：既然每一层都沉睡着上一层的潜能，问'当前层的深处还沉睡着什么'——把过渡性写成结构位置
给演化留阻力账：识别涌现路径上的'黑暗力量'（惯性、返祖、偶然），不把方向论写成无痛的进步论
process_en: Interrogate the 'emergent new': is it truly ex nihilo or the awakening of something already present?—trace its involutionary deposits (which potentials long slept in place)
Rebuild the double-pass ladder: situate the current state in both directions—out of which layers it involuted, toward which layers it may evolve
Project the next station: since each layer sleeps on the potential of the next, ask 'what still sleeps in the depths of the current layer'—write transitionality as a structural position
Book the resistance: identify the 'dark forces' on the emergence path (inertia, atavism, chance) so the doctrine of direction does not become a painless progressivism

对达尔文主义的双向处理：接受变异选择为机制，同时以'内卷存根'解释各站潜能的恰好涌现——演化方向与机制的分层解释
《人类循环论》把双程法用于社会：社会由符号心智经理性心智向灵性心智演化——文明的每一形态都是尚未完成的觉醒
representative_cases_en: The cosmological legislation of The Life Divine: the Divine involutes into matter and evolution re-awakens it layer by layer—'man is a transitional being' derived as a structural conclusion

modes.domain_zh: 奥罗宾多最广为流传的一句话是'人是过渡存在'（man is a transitional being）——《神圣人生论》开篇即把人类的自我形象从'万物之灵的成品'改写为'演化途中的工件'。这个改写是方法论动作而非修辞：判断任何现状（一个人、一个组织、一个文明）之前，先执行'过程定位'——它由什么而来、正处在哪一站、下一站是什么？一旦定位完成，评价标准立即改变：传统印度思想把人生视为轮回中待解脱的困境，现代进步主义把它视为已达成品的完善问题，奥罗宾多把两者都推翻——人生既非待逃离的困境也非待完善的成品，而是待超越的中间站。此动作的三重效力：其一，对自满：既然是中间站，任何'完成'都是错觉，心智的骄傲（自以为理性即终点）是演化滞留的症状；其二，对绝望：既然是中间站，任何'不完备'都是工件属性而非存在判决，困境可转化；其三，对方向：中间站的唯一有意义的问题是'下一站是什么、如何到'，所有标准都应从'现在好不好'改写为'是否有利于下一层涌现'。代价与极限：'过渡'叙事易被滥用为无限延期——'我还在路上'可以成为永不交付的托辞；且把现状贬为过渡可能系统性地低估当前阶段的真实价值与义务——奥罗宾多自己用'当下的完善仍是义务'来平衡，但实践中的平衡点依赖判断。
modes.domain_en: Aurobindo's most-quoted sentence is 'man is a transitional being'—The Life Divine opens by rewriting humanity's self-image from 'finished crown of creation' to 'work in progress on the evolutionary way.' The rewrite is a methodological move, not rhetoric: before judging any current state (a person, an organization, a civilization), run the process-positioning pass—out of what did it come, at which station does it stand, what is the next station? Once positioned, the criteria change at once: classical Indian thought sees life as a predicament awaiting release, modern progressivism as a finished product awaiting polish; Aurobindo overturns both—life is neither a predicament to flee nor a product to perfect but a way-station to be transcended. The move has a triple effect. Against complacency: being a way-station, any 'completion' is illusion, and the mind's pride (reason as the terminus) is the symptom of evolutionary stalling. Against despair: being a way-station, any 'incompleteness' is a work-in-progress property, not an existential verdict—the predicament is transformable. For direction: the only meaningful question at a way-station is 'what is the next station and how to get there'; every standard should be rewritten from 'is it good now' to 'does it favor the next emergence.' Costs and limits: the 'transitional' narrative is easily abused into infinite deferral—'I am still on the way' can become the excuse for never delivering; and discounting the present as transitional may systematically undervalue the real worth and obligations of the current stage—Aurobindo himself balanced with 'perfection of the present remains a duty,' but the balance point in practice depends on judgment.

process_zh: 拒绝'成品假设'：对任何现状先不评价好坏，而是执行过程定位三问——由什么演化而来、正处哪一站、下一站是什么

加装交付约束：为'过渡'设限——每一站必须有当下义务与阶段性完成物，防止'在路上'变成无限延期
process_en: Refuse the finished-product assumption: before judging any current state, run the three questions of process positioning—from what did it evolve, at which station does it stand, what is the next station

Reset the criteria: rewrite 'is it good now' as 'does it favor the next emergence'—rank and choose by evolutionary position, not static perfection
Install a delivery constraint: bound the 'transitional'—each station must carry present obligations and a stage deliverable, so 'on the way' cannot become infinite deferral

category: 目标工程化方法论/把不可企及的大目标拆成三个递进可执行的层级（心灵转化—灵性转化—超心智转化），每层有自己的入口、障碍与完成判据——逐层打通而非一次性跳跃
modes.domain_zh: 《瑜伽综合论》的核心工艺。奥罗宾多面对的工程问题是：' divine life on earth'（神圣人生）这个目标大到无法一次执行——传统修行一次跳跃（见性/解脱）只完成个体超越，不改写身体与生活。他的解法是分程：第一程'心灵转化'——在表层人格之下找到'心灵存在'（psychic being，灵魂/真实自我），让它的偏好与指引接管日常动机；入口是向内的沉潜，判据是动机系统的改换。第二程'灵性转化'——向上层意识（高等心智、启明心智、直觉心智、超心）开敞，让静默、光与力量降入心智与生命；判据是持续的上层连通而非偶发体验。第三程'超心智转化'——真理意识降入最稠密层，改写心智、生命、身体的本性本身；奥罗宾多承认此程尚未完成、'或需数百年'。分程的关键工艺特性：其一，次第不可跳越——未完成心灵转化而强开上层，会得到'中间地带'的混杂经验而非转化；其二，每程有独立的失败模式与安全规程；其三，总目标被保留而不被稀释——分程是执行策略不是目标折价。此法使'不可能的目标'第一次拥有甘特图。代价与极限：层级划分本身依赖其形上学（意识层级图谱），换一个传统划分方式即失效；且第三程永远'未完成'使整个工艺无法被完整验证——批评者可指其为不可证伪的递延结构；实践中的分程依赖导师判断，标准化程度低。
modes.domain_en: The core craft of The Synthesis of Yoga. Aurobindo faces an engineering problem: the goal of 'divine life on earth' is too large to execute in one pass—the traditional single leap (awakening, liberation) completes only individual transcendence and never rewrites body and life. His solution is staging. Stage one, the psychic transformation: beneath the surface personality find the psychic being (the soul, the true self) and let its preference and guidance take over daily motivation; entrance is the inward dive, the test is a changed motivational system. Stage two, the spiritual transformation: open to the higher planes (Higher Mind, Illumined Mind, Intuitive Mind, Overmind) and let silence, light and force descend into mind and life; the test is continuous higher connectivity, not episodic experience. Stage three, the supramental transformation: the Truth-Consciousness descends into the densest layer and rewrites the very nature of mind, life and body; Aurobindo concedes this stage is unaccomplished and 'may take centuries.' Key craft properties of the staging: the sequence cannot be skipped—forcing the higher levels without the psychic work yields mixed 'intermediate-zone' experiences, not transformation; each stage has its own failure modes and safety protocols; and the total goal is preserved undiluted—staging is an execution strategy, not a discount on the aim. The method gives 'the impossible goal' its first Gantt chart. Costs and limits: the level divisions hang on his metaphysics (the map of consciousness planes)—redivided by another tradition, the staging fails; the forever-unfinished third stage makes the whole craft impossible to verify completely—critics may call it an unfalsifiable deferral structure; and in practice staging depends on the judgment of guides, with low standardization.
modes.definition_zh: 目标工程化方法论/把不可企及的大目标拆成三个递进层级，每层有入口、障碍与完成判据——次第不可跳越、总目标不折价：给不可能的目标画甘特图
modes.definition_en: Goal-engineering methodology/break the unreachable goal into three ascending levels, each with entrance, obstacle and completion test—the sequence cannot be skipped and the total aim is undiluted: a Gantt chart for the impossible

key_concepts: 心灵转化 psychic transformation（发现内在灵魂并让其接管动机）
灵性转化 spiritual transformation（向上层意识开敞并持续降入）
超心智转化 supramental transformation（真理意识改写身心的本性）
次第不可跳越 non-skippable sequence（越级强开得中间地带混杂经验）

modes.key_quote_zh: 转化的路径有三程：先寻得心灵，再开向高处的光，最后让光降入泥土——每一程都不可跳越，每一程都以下一程为完成。
modes.key_quote_en: The path of transformation has three stages: first find the soul, then open to the light above, last let the light descend into the clay—no stage may be skipped, and each is completed only by the next.
process_zh: 把总目标显式写出，并承认其'一次性不可执行'——写下'为什么单次跳跃不够'（哪些层面单跳触及不到）
划分递进层级：每一层只解决总目标的一个切片，并为其定义入口（怎么进入）、主要障碍（怎么失败）与完成判据（怎么算过）
声明次第与依赖：明确哪些层级必须先于哪些层级，以及越级的已知风险——把'不可跳越'写成规程而非建议
设验证与交付点：每层有可观察的阶段性完成物，总目标设长期里程碑——既保持目标不折价，又让进度可被检验
process_en: Write out the total goal explicitly and concede it 'unexecutable in one pass'—state why a single leap is insufficient (which layers a leap cannot reach)
Divide the ascending levels: let each level solve one slice of the total goal, defining its entrance (how to enter), chief obstacle (how it fails) and completion test (what counts as cleared)
Declare sequence and dependency: make explicit which levels must precede which, and the known risks of skipping—write 'non-skippable' as protocol, not advice
Set verification and delivery points: each level gets observable stage deliverables, the total goal long-range milestones—keeping the aim undiluted while making progress testable
representative_cases_zh: 《瑜伽综合论》的三程立法：心灵—灵性—超心智各配入口与判据——'神圣人生'第一次获得工程化的路径
对'中间地带'的警告：未完成心灵转化而强开上层者得到混杂体验而非转化——次第规程的负面教材驱动立法

Siddhi Day 1926 and the long project: after announcing the Overmind's descent into the physical, the next twenty-four years given to silent work on the third stage—the staging method's self-conscious timescale
modern_applications_zh: 组织级大目标的分程治理：把'数字化转型'这类十年目标拆为三程（流程电子化—数据驱动—智能化），每程配入口、障碍与验收判据，并明文禁止跳程

AI 能力路线图的阶段化：把'通用智能'类总目标拆为有依赖关系的层级，每层有判据与已知风险清单——直接复用'次第不可跳越'与'中间地带'两个概念
modern_applications_en: Stage governance for organization-level goals: break a ten-year aim like 'digital transformation' into three stages (process digitization—data-driven—intelligent), each with entrance, obstacle and acceptance test, skipping expressly forbidden

Anti-frustration design for personal goals: break 'becoming a leader in a field' into three stages and accept that 'the third may take a decade'—neither abandoning the aim for its distance nor skipping levels out of impatience (skipping maps to the known failure mode of hothouse learning)

Staged roadmaps for AI capability: decompose goals like 'general intelligence' into dependent levels with tests and risk lists per level—reusing 'non-skippable sequence' and 'intermediate zone' as working concepts

name_en: systemic-synthesis methodology/refuse to make any real facet the whole: knowledge, love, action and the body each see something and each have limits—synthesis is not juxtaposition or compromise but giving each path its station in a higher unity: the legislative principle of Integral Yoga
category: 系统综合方法论/拒绝把任一真实面向当成全部：知识、爱、行动、身体四道各有所见亦各有局限——综合不是并列折中，而是让每一道在更高的统一中各就其位：'整体瑜伽'的立法原则
modes.domain_zh: '整体'（purna）一词就是此法的立法标记。奥罗宾多的诊断：人类修行史是不断'以偏概全'的历史——智瑜伽独尊知识而枯，爱瑜伽独尊情感而狂，业瑜伽独尊行动而缚，苦行独尊身体而戕；每一道都抓住了真实的面向，也都把面向当成了全部。他既不裁决哪道最优，也不折中各取一半，而是执行第三种操作：把四道放入一个更高的统一结构，让每一道在结构中'各就其位'——知识为整体的照明，爱为整体的联结，行动为整体的外显，身体为整体的最后阵地。与'折中主义'的三重区别：其一，折中是在同一层面各让一步，统摄是升一个层面让各方全保；其二，折中产生次优的混合物，统摄产生原先各方都不可能单独达到的产物（个体转化且世界转化的目标，是任何单道都给不出的）；其三，折中稀释目标，统摄扩容目标。此法同样用于他处理印度与西方：不接受'东方灵性优于西方科学'也不接受反向，而是把科学与灵性放进同一个'意识演化'结构里各就其位——《神圣人生论》正是这个统摄操作的示范文本。代价与极限：统摄需要'更高的统一结构'真实存在，否则只是漂亮的并列——那个结构（意识层级/神圣整体）又是形上学断言；且统摄在实践上最难执行：四道并修的资源与注意力成本极高，'各就其位'的分工规则在操作层常退化为'什么都来一点'。
modes.domain_en: The word 'integral' (purna) is this method's legislative marker. Aurobindo's diagnosis: the history of human practice is a history of mistaking the part for the whole—the path of knowledge alone dries, of love alone burns, of action alone binds, of asceticism alone maims; each path seizes a real facet and mistakes the facet for everything. He neither adjudicates which path is best nor splits the difference, but performs a third operation: place the four paths inside a higher unifying structure where each 'takes its station'—knowledge as the illumination of the whole, love as its bond, action as its outflow, the body as its last redoubt. Three differences from 'eclecticism': compromise concedes a step on the same level, synthesis ascends a level and keeps all parties whole; compromise yields an inferior mixture, synthesis a product none of the parties could reach alone (individual-plus-world transformation is given by no single path); compromise dilutes the goal, synthesis enlarges it. He applies the same method to India and the West: accepting neither 'Eastern spirit over Western science' nor the reverse, he places science and spirituality inside one structure—the evolution of consciousness—each at its station; The Life Divine is the demonstration text of this operation. Costs and limits: synthesis needs the 'higher unifying structure' to be real, or it is merely elegant juxtaposition—and that structure (the planes of consciousness, the divine whole) is a metaphysical assertion; and synthesis is the hardest to execute: fourfold practice carries immense resource and attention costs, and the division-of-stations rule degenerates in operation into 'a little of everything.'
modes.definition_zh: 系统综合方法论/四道各有所见亦各有局限——综合不是并列折中而是升层统摄：让每一道在更高的统一中各就其位，产出任何单道单独给不出的结果
modes.definition_en: Systemic-synthesis methodology/each path sees something and each has limits—synthesis is not juxtaposed compromise but ascent-level integration: give each path its station in a higher unity and yield what no single path could give alone
modes.source_chapter: 《瑜伽综合论》第一部分论'四道综合'的原则；《神圣人生论》对东西方知识体系的统摄处理；《薄伽梵歌论》对行动—知识—虔爱三道在'有为而无执'中的统一
key_concepts: 整体 purna（无遗漏的全体——立法标记词）
四道综合 the four paths synthesized（知识、爱、行动、身体各就其位）
升层统摄 ascent-level synthesis（与同层折中的三重区别）
各就其位 each path at its station（分工规则：照明/联结/外显/阵地）
目标扩容 goal enlargement（统摄产出单方不可能的复合目标）
modes.key_quote_zh: 真正的综合不是各让一步，而是升一层让各方全保——每一道都是整体的一个器官，砍去任何一道，整体即残。
modes.key_quote_en: True synthesis does not split differences but ascends a level keeping all parties whole—each path is an organ of the whole; cut one and the whole is maimed.
process_zh: 盘点'各有所见'：列出竞争各方各自真实抓住的面向——先承认每一方的局部正确，再谈综合
找出或构建更高的统一结构：能同时安放各方的那个框架是什么？——若找不到现成的，就立法新建（如'意识演化'统摄科学与灵性）
为每一方写分工规则：它在统一结构中负责什么、边界在哪、与谁衔接——'各就其位'要能回答'这一方何时让位'
检验扩容产出：综合后是否出现了任何一方单独给不出的新目标或新能力？——没有扩容产出的'综合'即退回并列，重新升层
process_en: Inventory what each party truly sees: list the real facet each competitor holds—grant every party its local correctness before speaking of synthesis
Find or build the higher unifying structure: which framework can house all parties?—if none exists, legislate a new one (as 'the evolution of consciousness' housed science and spirit)
Write the division-of-stations rule: what each party is responsible for in the unified structure, its boundaries, its hand-offs—'each at its station' must answer 'when does this party yield'

Test for enlargement: does the synthesis yield a new goal or capability none of the parties could give alone?—an 'integration' without enlargement has fallen back into juxtaposition; ascend a level again
representative_cases_zh: 《瑜伽综合论》的四道统摄：智、爱、业、行（身体）各就其位——'整体瑜伽'得名于此操作
《薄伽梵歌论》的重新解读：把'行动—知识—虔爱'三道统一于'有为而无执'——以统摄取代传统'哪道最尊'的裁决
东西方知识的统摄处理：科学与灵性被安放在'意识演化'的同一结构中——《神圣人生论》的写作结构本身即示范
representative_cases_en: The fourfold synthesis of The Synthesis of Yoga: knowledge, love, action and the body each at its station—the operation from which 'Integral Yoga' takes its name
The rereading of the Gita: knowledge, devotion and action unified in 'work without clinging'—synthesis replacing the traditional adjudication of 'which path is supreme'
The integral treatment of Eastern and Western knowledge: science and spirituality housed in the one structure of the evolution of consciousness—The Life Divine's very architecture as demonstration
modern_applications_zh: 学科交叉与团队组建：把竞争方法论（定量/定性、工程/设计）放进更高的统一问题结构并写分工规则，以'扩容产出'检验是否真综合——防止' interdisciplinary'沦为并列贴标签
产品路线的多目标治理：性能/成本/体验各有所见——升层到'用户任务的完成结构'里各就其位，而非在原层各让一步
个人能力栈设计：'深度专精'与'广度通识'之争以统摄处理：专精为照明、通识为联结、输出为外显——并为三者写清衔接与让位规则
modern_applications_en: Interdisciplinary team design: put rival methodologies (quant/qual, engineering/design) inside a higher unifying problem structure with written division-of-stations rules, and test for enlargement output—so 'interdisciplinary' does not degenerate into labeled juxtaposition

Multi-objective product governance: performance, cost and experience each see something—ascend to 'the structure of the user's task completion' and give each its station, rather than conceding steps at the original level

Personal capability-stack design: treat the depth-vs-breadth debate by synthesis—specialization as illumination, generalism as bond, output as expression—with clear hand-off and yield rules among the three

name_zh: 成果验证方法论/一切高级状态的检验不在其上的清晰而在其下的落地：意识、能力或制度必须降入最稠密的日常层（身体、琐务、现金流）并改写它才算完成——'高而未降'只是体验不是成就
name_en: achievement-verification methodology/the test of any higher state lies not in its clarity above but in its landing below: consciousness, capability or institution counts as achieved only when it descends into the densest everyday layer (body, chores, cash flow) and rewrites it—'high but not descended' is experience, not attainment
category: 成果验证方法论/一切高级状态的检验不在其上的清晰而在其下的落地：意识、能力或制度必须降入最稠密的日常层（身体、琐务、现金流）并改写它才算完成——'高而未降'只是体验不是成就
modes.domain_zh: 奥罗宾多与传统灵性路线最锋利的分岔在此。传统修行以'高层体验'为成就判据（见性、三摩地、狂喜），他反过来立法：上层体验再清晰也不算数，唯一有效的检验是降入——获得的意识必须降回身体、情绪与日常琐务并改写它们的运行，'神圣生命必须降入泥土'。理由是结构性的：只在高层的转变会形成'分层人格'（上面是光、下面照旧），而演化意义上的转化要求最稠密层（物质/身体）本身被改写——这是他区别于一切'出离型'灵性的分水岭。此法作为通用验证器同样锋利：任何'高维能力'（战略、理论、愿景）若不能降入最稠密的执行层并改写它，就只是体验而非能力；任何'先进制度'若不能降入基层的日常操作，就只是文件。检验的操作化：找到该系统的'最稠密层'（变化最难发生的地方），检查高层成果在那里留下了什么痕迹——痕迹为零即'高而未降'。奥罗宾多晚年把整个修道院工作压缩为一句话：'把瑜伽带进细胞'。代价与极限：降入检验耗时最长（底层改写以年计），会系统性低估'高层先行'探索期的价值——需要与允许未落地的'探索账户'配合使用；且'降入'的深度没有天然上限（细胞层之下还有分子层），检验标准需人为封顶，否则 perfectionism 会吞掉一切成果。
modes.domain_en: Here lies Aurobindo's sharpest divergence from the traditional spiritual routes. Classical practice takes 'higher experience' as the criterion of attainment (awakening, samadhi, ecstasy); he legislates the reverse: however clear the higher experience, it does not count—the only valid test is descent: the gained consciousness must come back down into body, emotion and daily chores and rewrite their operation—'the divine life must descend into the clay.' The reason is structural: transformation that stays high produces a 'stratified personality' (light above, business as usual below), while transformation in the evolutionary sense requires the densest layer (matter, the body) itself to be rewritten—his watershed from every 'otherworldly' spirituality. As a universal verifier the method is equally sharp: any 'high-level capability' (strategy, theory, vision) that cannot descend into the densest execution layer and rewrite it is experience, not capability; any 'advanced institution' that cannot descend into grassroots daily operation is a document. To operationalize the test: find the system's densest layer (where change is hardest), and inspect what traces the higher achievement left there—zero traces means 'high but not descended.' In his last years Aurobindo compressed the whole ashram work into one sentence: 'bring the yoga into the cells.' Costs and limits: descent takes the longest (bottom-layer rewriting is measured in years) and systematically undervalues the exploration period of 'higher-first' work—it needs pairing with an 'exploration account' that permits not-yet-landed work; and 'descent' has no natural floor (beneath the cells lie molecules), so the standard must be capped by convention, else perfectionism swallows every result.
modes.definition_zh: 成果验证方法论/高级状态的唯一有效检验是降入最稠密日常层并改写它——上层体验再清晰，'高而未降'只是体验不是成就
modes.definition_en: Achievement-verification methodology/the only valid test of a higher state is descending into the densest everyday layer and rewriting it—however clear the higher experience, 'high but not descended' is experience, not attainment
modes.source_chapter: 《瑜伽综合论》论'降入身体'与瑜伽的转化目标；《神圣人生论》论'神圣生命的落地'；晚年书信'把瑜伽带进细胞'（Letters on Yoga）
key_concepts: 降入 descent（意识/能力回返最稠密层的下行检验）
最稠密层 the densest layer（变化最难发生处——身体、琐务、现金流）
分层人格 the stratified personality（上光下旧的转变失败形态）
痕迹检验 the trace test（在稠密层检查高层成果的留下物）
出离型灵性的分水岭 the watershed from otherworldly spirituality（转化世界 vs 离开世界）
modes.key_quote_zh: 除非光降入泥土并改写泥土，否则它只是高处的一场照明——把瑜伽带进细胞。
modes.key_quote_en: Unless the light descends into the clay and rewrites the clay, it is only an illumination upstairs—bring the yoga into the cells.
process_zh: 识别系统的'最稠密层'：问'哪里最难改变'——身体的习惯、组织的琐务流程、财务的现金流，找到变化阻力最大处
把高层成果投影到稠密层：该成果在这个层上应留下什么痕迹？——写出具体的可观察改变（行为、流程、数字）
执行痕迹检验：到稠密层实地检查——痕迹为零或只在上层可见，即判'高而未降'，成果记为'体验'而非'成就'
规划降入工程：为高层成果设计下行路线（哪些载体、哪些步骤把它带进最稠密层），并以稠密层的改写度作为最终验收
process_en: Identify the system's densest layer: ask 'where is change hardest'—bodily habit, the organization's routine procedures, financial cash flow; locate the point of maximal resistance
Project the higher achievement onto the dense layer: what traces should it leave there?—write out the concrete observable changes (behaviors, procedures, numbers)
Run the trace test: inspect the dense layer on the ground—zero traces, or traces visible only upstairs, means 'high but not descended'; record the result as 'experience,' not 'attainment'

Plan the descent work: design the downward route for the higher achievement (which carriers, which steps bring it into the densest layer), and accept the dense layer's degree of rewriting as the final验收
representative_cases_zh: 对传统'高层体验'判据的立法性否决：三摩地与狂喜被降格为'体验'——唯一的成就判据改为降入身体与日常的改写
晚年'把瑜伽带进细胞'：把体系的最稠密检验层一路下压到生理层——降入检验的极致版本
《母亲的议程》的实测记录：三十年逐日记录降入身体过程的反弹、失败与微进展——降入检验费时性的第一手数据
representative_cases_en: The legislative veto of the traditional 'higher experience' criterion: samadhi and ecstasy demoted to 'experience'—the only attainment criterion rewritten as descent and the rewriting of body and daily life
The late-life 'bring the yoga into the cells': pressing the system's densest test-layer all the way down to the physiological—the extreme version of the descent test
The field records of The Agenda of the Mother: thirty years of daily entries on the descent into the body, its backlashes, failures and micro-progress—the first-hand data on how long descent takes
modern_applications_zh: 战略落地的验收标准：战略共识会（高层体验）不算完成，唯当战略降入周例会、考核指标与一线流程并改写它们——'痕迹检验'直接用于判断变革是否真实发生
学习成果验证：'听懂了/震撼了'不算学会，唯当知识降入'最稠密层'（默认操作习惯、每天的产出物）——把'体验与成就'区分制度化
制度落地评估：新制度降入基层日常操作（表格、审批动线）才算建成——'高而未降'的制度即为文件
modern_applications_en: Acceptance criteria for strategy: the strategy offsite (the higher experience) is not completion—only when strategy descends into weekly meetings, KPIs and frontline procedures and rewrites them; the 'trace test' applied directly to whether change is real

Verification of learning outcomes: 'understood it / was moved by it' is not learning—only when knowledge descends into the densest layer (default habits, daily outputs); institutionalize the distinction between experience and attainment
Institution-landing assessment: a new institution counts as built only when it descends into grassroots daily operations (forms, approval flows)—a 'high but not descended' institution is a document

name_zh: 认知架构方法论/把'意识'从单一变量展开为多层结构（物质—生命—心智—高等心智—启明—直觉—超心—超心智），并为每一层写明其运作方式与失效模式——解释力来自把争论定位到层
name_en: cognitive-architecture methodology/expand 'consciousness' from a single variable into a layered structure (matter—life—mind—Higher Mind—Illumined—Intuitive—Overmind—Supermind), specifying each layer's mode of operation and failure modes—explanatory power comes from locating disputes at a layer
category: 认知架构方法论/把'意识'从单一变量展开为多层结构（物质—生命—心智—高等心智—启明—直觉—超心—超心智），并为每一层写明其运作方式与失效模式——解释力来自把争论定位到层
modes.domain_zh: 奥罗宾多最独特的技术资产是一张意识层级地图。他拒绝把'意识'当单一变量（更聪明/更专注），而是展开为有质的差异的层：普通心智（分割性思维）、高等心智（清晰的思想力）、启明心智（见光的思维）、直觉心智（直接知）、超心（看见多是一的宇宙视角）、超心智（统一与多并存而不分裂的真理意识）——向下还有生命层（欲力）与物质层。地图的用法有三。其一，解释法：许多'想不通'不是能力不足而是层级错置——用分割性心智处理'统一性问题'必然失败，正如用一维工具画高维对象；把争论定位到层，问题立即改观。其二，诊断法：每一层有专属失效模式（直觉层的失效是'过度确信'，超心层的失效是'全景而无法执行'）——知道自己在哪层，才知道该防什么。其三，升层法：遇到当前层不可解的问题，不是加大力度而是升层——'在心智层无解的问题，在直觉层可能自明'。此图与三重转化（M-AUR-003）配套：转化就是沿着这张图的定向迁移。代价与极限：层级划分依赖内省传统而缺乏外部测量，层间边界在实践中模糊（谁在判断'这是直觉还是高级心智'？）；且地图易被挪用为身份等级（'我在超心层'），奥罗宾多本人警告把层级体验当作成就恰是中间地带的标志。
modes.domain_en: Aurobindo's most distinctive technical asset is a map of the planes of consciousness. He refuses to treat consciousness as a single variable (smarter, more focused) and expands it into qualitatively distinct layers: ordinary mind (divisive thought), Higher Mind (clear thought-power), Illumined Mind (thought seeing light), Intuitive Mind (direct knowing), Overmind (the cosmic view seeing multiplicity as one), Supermind (the truth-consciousness holding unity and multiplicity undivided)—and downward, the vital layer and the material layer. The map has three uses. Explanation: many 'unsolvable' problems are layer-mismatches—handling a question of unity with a divisive mind must fail, as one-dimensional tools drawing higher-dimensional objects; locate the dispute at a layer and the problem changes at once. Diagnosis: each layer has signature failure modes (at the intuitive layer, over-certainty; at the Overmind, panoramic vision with no grip for execution)—knowing which layer you are on tells you what to guard against. Ascent: when a problem is unsolvable at the current layer, the move is not more effort but a higher layer—'a question unsolvable at the mental layer may be self-evident at the intuitive.' The map pairs with the triple transformation (M-AUR-003): transformation is directed migration along it. Costs and limits: the layer divisions rest on an introspective tradition without external measurement, and the boundaries blur in practice (who judges 'is this intuition or Higher Mind'?); and the map is easily misused as a status hierarchy ('I am at the Overmind')—Aurobindo himself warned that treating plane-experiences as attainment is precisely the mark of the intermediate zone.
modes.definition_zh: 认知架构方法论/把意识展开为质的层级地图并为每层写明运作与失效模式——用'定位到层'解释想不通的问题、诊断失效模式、以升层代替加力
modes.definition_en: Cognitive-architecture methodology/expand consciousness into a qualitative layered map with each layer's operation and failure modes specified—explain by locating at a layer, diagnose by failure mode, ascend instead of pushing harder
modes.source_chapter: 《神圣人生论》论'心智之上的诸层级'；《瑜伽综合论》对直觉与超心的区分；书信集对'超心与超心智之别'的系统说明
key_concepts: 意识层级 the planes of consciousness（心智之上的高等心智—启明—直觉—超心—超心智序列）
层间质的差异 qualitative layer difference（升层不是变聪明而是换运作方式）
层专属失效模式 layer-specific failure modes（直觉层的过度确信、超心层的全景无执行）
层定位解释 layer-locating explanation（想不通多为层级错置）
升层法 the ascent move（当前层无解的问题升层处理）
modes.key_quote_zh: 心智之上还有心智，光之上还有光——你不是想得不够用力，你是站错了层。
modes.key_quote_en: Above mind there are minds, above light more light—your trouble is not that you are not trying hard enough, but that you stand on the wrong layer.
process_zh: 把'意识/能力'显式展开为层级图：列出各层（至少区分：习惯执行层—分析层—直觉层—全景层），并给每层写运作方式
对眼前的困难做层定位：这个问题本质上是哪一层的问题？用哪一层的工具在处理它？——识别层级错置
查该层的失效模式库：当前层的典型失败是什么（分析层的过度还原、直觉层的过度确信）——先防层内失效再谈升层
决定升层或加力：判断问题是'当前层内可解但难'还是'当前层内不可解'——前者加力，后者升层；并为升层设计过渡路径
process_en: Expand 'consciousness/capability' into an explicit layer map: list the layers (at minimum: habitual execution—analysis—intuition—panorama) and write each layer's mode of operation
Locate the present difficulty at a layer: which layer does this problem essentially belong to, and with whose tools is it being handled?—identify the layer mismatch
Consult the layer's failure-mode library: what typically fails at this layer (over-reduction at analysis, over-certainty at intuition)—guard against in-layer failure before considering ascent

Decide between ascent and effort: is the problem 'solvable within the layer but hard' or 'unsolvable within the layer'?—the former calls for effort, the latter for ascent; and design the transition path upward
representative_cases_zh: 心智之上诸层级的系统立法：高等心智—启明—直觉—超心—超心智的序列与各自的运作描述——意识从单变量展开为结构
超心与超心智之别的反复澄清：两者极易被混同，奥罗宾多以'全景而未整合'与'统一而多并存'划界——层间差异精细化的示范
对'中间地带'的层诊断：修行者把高层体验误当成就而停滞——地图的失效模式库直接用于识别人格级风险
representative_cases_en: The systematic legislation of the planes above mind: the sequence Higher Mind—Illumined—Intuitive—Overmind—Supermind with each layer's operation described—consciousness expanded from a variable into a structure

The repeated clarification of Overmind versus Supermind: easily conflated, bounded by 'panoramic but not integrated' against 'unity holding multiplicity undivided'—a demonstration of refining layer boundaries
The layer-diagnosis of the 'intermediate zone': practitioners mistaking higher experiences for attainment and stalling—the map's failure-mode library applied to person-level risk
modern_applications_zh: 组织决策的层定位：把'争论不休'诊断为层级错置——用执行层的 KPI 工具处理使命层的统一性问题必然失败；先定位层再谈方法
个人认知升级的路径图：区分'分析力提升'（层内加力）与'视角升层'（换运作方式）——解决'努力很久无进展'的常见误诊
AI 系统的能力描述规范：把'智能'展开为多层（检索—推理—直觉式泛化—全局规划）并为每层写失效模式——层级地图法在工程语境的直接移植
modern_applications_en: Layer-locating in organizational decisions: diagnose 'endless dispute' as layer mismatch—handling a mission-level question of unity with execution-layer KPI tools must fail; locate the layer before debating method

A path map for personal cognitive upgrading: distinguish 'better analysis' (in-layer effort) from 'changing layers' (a different mode of operation)—correcting the common misdiagnosis of 'long effort, no progress'

Capability-description standards for AI systems: expand 'intelligence' into layers (retrieval—reasoning—intuitive generalization—global planning) with failure modes per layer—a direct transplant of the layer map into engineering
related_modes: M-AUR-003（三重转化分程法——转化就是沿此图的定向迁移，分程是地图上的导航规程）
M-AUR-001（内卷演化双程法——层级地图是双程阶梯的细化刻度）
M-WJM-004（威廉·詹姆斯·实用主义兑现检验法——近缘对照：詹姆斯以兑现价值检验且坚持多元反等级，奥罗宾多给出严格层级与方向——'多元'与'层级'两种意识分类学）
M-KD-001（康德·批判转折法（哥白尼式革命）——反向对照：康德以理性边界封顶认识，奥罗宾多以层级地图开路——'封顶'与'升层'对'不可解'的相反处置）

representative_figures.relation_en: the methodological parallel—another meticulous cartographer of consciousness, though James insists on plurality without rank while Aurobindo insists the layers have a direction

representative_figures.relation_zh: 古代先例——线喻把认识分为想象、信念、理智、理性四层，是层级地图法的最早蓝图之一

name_zh: 事业交接与精力管理方法论/把'入世行动'与'内在工作'并行收存：外在事业（革命、建院）在使命转向时不必推倒，而是封存为伏藏——交托给既有的力量与后人，转身投入更高优先级而不弃前功
name_en: handover and energy-management methodology/run outward action and inward work in parallel and store the former when the mission turns: the outer enterprise (revolution, ashram) need not be demolished at a pivot but sealed as an entrustment—handed to existing forces and successors while one turns to the higher priority without abandoning prior work
category: 事业交接与精力管理方法论/把'入世行动'与'内在工作'并行收存：外在事业（革命、建院）在使命转向时不必推倒，而是封存为伏藏——交托给既有的力量与后人，转身投入更高优先级而不弃前功
modes.domain_zh: 1909-1910 年的转身是此法的原型示范。奥罗宾多从阿利普尔监狱出来时是全印最著名的革命领袖，按常理只有两条路：继续革命或放弃革命投身灵修。他执行了第三条：既不推倒也不恋栈——判断'印度独立的必然性已由大势保证，我的个人介入不再必要'后，把革命事业'封存交托'：密谋网络交还其自身逻辑、报纸交托同侪（尼维蒂塔接编《业瑜伽》）、民族精神交托其已注入的运动本身；自己则按'上界之命'赴本地治里转入静默工作。关键设计：其一，'封存而非清算'——事业不宣布失败、不宣布完成，而是转为'他人可续、大势可成'的自主状态；其二，'交托判断'——确信该事业的成果已不依赖本人（独立由诸力合和保证），这是敢于抽身的根据；其三，'不弃前功'——转向不否定旧事业的价值，革命训练出的组织力、表达力、号召力全部转入新工作（他后来的全部写作沿用革命时期的笔力）。代价与极限：交托判断本身极难——错判'已不依赖我'会导致事业无人接（现实中的革命网络在他离开后确实涣散）；且'封存'叙事可能被批评为体面撤退的话术包装——其效力完全取决于被交托对象是否真的续存。
modes.domain_en: The pivot of 1909-1910 is this method's prototype. Aurobindo emerged from Alipore jail as the most famous revolutionary in India; by ordinary logic there were two roads: continue the revolution or abandon it for the spiritual life. He executed a third: neither demolishing nor clinging—judging that 'the inevitability of India's independence was already assured by the march of forces, my personal intervention no longer indispensable,' he sealed the revolutionary enterprise in trust: the conspiratorial network returned to its own logic, the newspapers handed to peers (Nivedita took over Karmayogin), the national spirit entrusted to the movement it had been poured into; then, 'by a command from above,' he went to Pondicherry for silent work. Key design elements: sealing, not liquidating—the enterprise is declared neither failed nor finished but converted to a self-sustaining state that others may continue and the trend may complete; the entrustment judgment—certainty that the enterprise's outcome no longer depends on him (independence guaranteed by the convergence of forces) is the very ground for daring to withdraw; and no abandonment of prior gains—the turn repudiates nothing of the old work's value; the organizing power, expressiveness and mobilizing capacity trained by revolution all transfer into the new work (his later writing carries the pen of the revolutionary years). Costs and limits: the entrustment judgment is extremely hard—a wrong 'no longer depends on me' leaves the enterprise orphaned (in fact the revolutionary network did scatter after his departure); and 'sealing' may be criticized as rhetorical packaging of a decorous retreat—its validity rests wholly on whether the entrusted object truly carried on.
modes.definition_zh: 事业交接方法论/使命转向时对旧事业执行'封存交托'：确信成果已不依赖本人后，把事业转为自主续存状态并转身投入更高优先级——不推倒、不恋栈、不弃前功
modes.definition_en: Enterprise-handover methodology/at a mission pivot, execute 'seal and entrust' on the old enterprise: certain the outcome no longer depends on you, convert it to a self-sustaining state and turn to the higher priority—demolishing nothing, clinging to nothing, abandoning no prior gain
modes.source_chapter: 《奥罗宾多生平》论 1910 年赴本地治里之抉择（'奉上界之命'）；书信集对'为何退出政治'的自辩；乌塔帕拉演说对'事业归于大势'的表述
key_concepts: 封存而非清算 sealing, not liquidation（事业转为自主续存状态）
交托判断 the entrustment judgment（'成果已不依赖本人'的确信是抽身的根据）
不弃前功 no abandonment of prior gains（旧事业的技能与资产全数转入新工作）
双程并进 parallel tracks（入世行动与内在工作互为训练而非互斥）
奉命转身 the commanded pivot（以更高召唤为转身提供合法性）
modes.key_quote_zh: 印度之自由已由诸大势所保证，无须我之在场——故我封存此业而转身：非弃也，托也。
modes.key_quote_en: India's freedom is assured by the march of forces and needs not my presence—therefore I seal the work and turn: not abandonment, but entrustment.
process_zh: 执行'依赖性审计'：旧事业的成败现在依赖多少本人不可替代的投入？——若关键路径已可由他人与大势承担，记录依据
设计封存结构：把事业转为'他人可续、大势可成'的自主状态——明确交托对象（人、制度、已注入的精神），不留悬空
完成转身立法：以更高优先级或更高召唤为转身提供合法性（对内对外都讲清楚），并声明'非弃乃托'以保全旧事业的名义价值
迁移资产清单：列出旧事业中可迁移的技能、网络与信誉，显式接入新工作——防止转身变成净损失
process_en: Run the dependence audit: how much of the old enterprise's success now depends on irreplaceable personal input?—if the critical path can be carried by others and the trend, document the grounds

Design the sealing structure: convert the enterprise to a self-sustaining state 'continuable by others, completable by the trend'—name the entrusted objects (people, institutions, the spirit already instilled), leaving nothing suspended

Legislate the turn: ground the pivot in a higher priority or calling (stated clearly inwardly and outwardly), declaring 'not abandonment but entrustment' to preserve the old enterprise's nominal value
Move the asset list: inventory the transferable skills, networks and reputation from the old work and wire them explicitly into the new—so the turn is not a net loss
representative_cases_zh: 1910 年赴本地治里：判'独立已由大势保证'后封存革命事业——报纸交同侪、网络还其逻辑、本人转入静默工作，转身全程不弃笔力与组织力
《业瑜伽》《法》的交托：离岸前把刊物明确移交（尼维蒂塔接编）——封存结构中'交托对象明确'的示范
革命经验向写作的迁移：民族运动时期的政论笔力全数转入《阿雅亚》六年的密集产出——'不弃前功'的资产迁移实证
representative_cases_en: The 1910 move to Pondicherry: judging 'independence assured by the march of forces,' sealing the revolutionary enterprise—newspapers to peers, the network to its own logic, himself to silent work, with pen and organization fully migrated
The entrustment of Karmayogin and Dharma: before leaving, the journals explicitly handed over (Nivedita taking the editorship)—a model of 'named entrusted objects' in the sealing structure
The migration of revolutionary experience into writing: the polemical pen of the national years carried whole into six dense years of the Arya—empirical proof of 'no abandonment of prior gains'
modern_applications_zh: 创始人退居的规范流程：先做依赖性审计（公司离开我是否仍能成），再设计封存结构（明确的交托对象与机制），最后公开立法转身——为创始人退出提供'非弃乃托'的叙事与操作框架
多项目间的精力调度：并行项目在优先级转向时执行'封存交托'（转交对象、自主续存机制、资产迁移清单），避免'烂尾式放弃'与'恋栈式拖延'两个极端
职业生涯转型：旧职业技能与信誉显式迁移入新领域（革命笔力→哲学写作式的对应物），把'从头开始'的净损失叙事改写为'托业转身'
modern_applications_en: A disciplined founder step-back: run the dependence audit first (can the company succeed without me), then design the sealing structure (named entrusted objects and mechanisms), then legislate the turn publicly—an operating and narrative framework of 'not abandonment but entrustment' for founder exits

Energy scheduling across projects: when priorities pivot, execute 'seal and entrust' (handover targets, self-sustaining mechanisms, asset migration lists)—avoiding the twin extremes of烂尾式 abandonment and clinging procrastination

Career transitions: explicitly migrate old skills and reputation into the new field (the revolutionary pen into philosophical writing, in kind), rewriting the 'starting from zero' narrative of net loss into 'entrusted turn'
related_modes: M-AUR-010（人类统一收束法——伏藏的最终去向：一切事业收束于整体建制，个体转身是收束链条的一环）
M-AUR-005（降入检验法——封存交托的有效性也要过降入检验：被交托对象是否真的续存）
M-WZT-010（武则天·无字碑留白法——近缘对照：武则天以无字碑把身后解释权交托后世，奥罗宾多以封存把事业交托大势——两种'不以自身在场为条件'的收束）
M-LKY-006（李光耀·绝对条件坦白法——反向对照：李光耀以坦白残酷条件作为治理基础且始终在场，奥罗宾多以静默作用与判据化例外退场而为——在场直言与退场静默的两种作用）

name_zh: 影响力与干预方法论/以不在场的静默力量替代在场的直接干预：退出前台后保持对全局的'静默作用'（通信、原则声明、精神影响），干预保留为按需触发的例外而非常态——权变而不弃局
name_en: influence and intervention methodology/replace present direct intervention with an absent silent force: after leaving the front stage, keep a 'silent action' on the whole (letters, principled statements, spiritual influence), with intervention held as an on-demand exception, not a norm—adapting without abandoning the field
category: 影响力与干预方法论/以不在场的静默力量替代在场的直接干预：退出前台后保持对全局的'静默作用'（通信、原则声明、精神影响），干预保留为按需触发的例外而非常态——权变而不弃局
modes.domain_zh: 退隐本地治里后的四十年是此法的制度化实验。奥罗宾多的退出不是消失：其一，他建立了'静默影响'的通道——书信（后成《瑜伽书信集》数千通）、每年四次的达善日、对世界局势的持续注视；其二，他保留了干预的例外权——1940 年二战关键节点致信支持盟军（个人身份、明确立场），1942 年至克里普斯使命时期再度表态，两次干预皆为'按需触发'而非日常姿态；其三，他坚持'阿舒罗姆与政治无涉'的防火墙，使静默影响不被组织化利益污染。此法的结构原理：直接干预的边际效力随在场而递减（领袖在场则系统依赖领袖），静默影响反而给系统留出自我组织空间——'领袖不在场而原则在场'。干预例外的设计使静默不滑向失语：哪些节点必须发声（文明存亡级）预先有判据。此法与 M-AUR-007（伏藏法）构成'退出'的完整工艺：伏藏解决'旧事业怎么办'，静默权变解决'退出后如何继续起作用'。代价与极限：静默影响的实际效力不可验证（宣称的精神力量无从计量），批评者可指其为'退出后的自我安慰叙事'；且'按需触发'的判据依赖私人的洞察力，若判据失效则要么过度干预要么永久失语——历史只检验了两次触发，样本极小。
modes.domain_en: The forty years in Pondicherry were this method's institutionalized experiment. Aurobindo's withdrawal was not disappearance. First, he built channels of 'silent influence': thousands of letters (later the Letters on Yoga), four darshan days a year, a continuous watch on world affairs. Second, he reserved intervention as an exception—at the critical juncture of 1940 he wrote in support of the Allies (personal capacity, explicit position), and again around the Cripps Mission in 1942; both interventions were 'on-demand triggers,' not daily posture. Third, he kept a firewall that the ashram had nothing to do with politics, so the silent influence stayed uncontaminated by organized interest. The structural principle: the marginal efficacy of direct intervention declines with presence (a leader present makes the system depend on the leader), while silent influence leaves the system room to self-organize—'the leader absent, the principle present.' The design of the intervention exception keeps silence from sliding into speechlessness: which junctures must be voiced (civilizational-existence level) is settled by prior criteria. The method pairs with M-AUR-007 (entrustment) to make a complete craft of 'exit': entrustment solves 'what of the old enterprise,' silent force solves 'how to keep working after exit.' Costs and limits: the real efficacy of silent influence is unverifiable (claimed spiritual force cannot be measured); critics may call it a self-consoling narrative after exit; and the 'on-demand' criteria depend on private insight—if the criteria fail, one either over-intervenes or falls permanently silent—history tested only two triggers, a very small sample.
modes.definition_zh: 影响力方法论/退出前台后以静默力量持续作用于全局——通信、原则、精神影响为常态，干预保留为按需触发的例外：领袖不在场而原则在场
modes.definition_en: Influence methodology/after leaving the front stage, keep acting on the whole through silent force—letters, principles and spiritual influence as the norm, intervention held as an on-demand exception: the leader absent, the principle present
modes.source_chapter: 书信集（Letters on Yoga）对'静默行动'的表述；1940 年与 1942 年两次公开表态文本；《奥罗宾多生平》论'退隐中的注视与干预'
key_concepts: 静默影响 silent influence（书信、达善、注视构成的不在场作用通道）
干预例外 the intervention exception（按需触发、有预判据的发声）
领袖不在场而原则在场 the leader absent, the principle present（给系统自我组织留空间）
组织防火墙 the organizational firewall（静默影响不被组织利益污染）
触发判据 the trigger criteria（何种节点必须打破静默的预先标准）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不在场，但并非无所作为——静默的作用比喧哗的干预更深入：原则代替我出席。
modes.key_quote_en: I am absent, but not inactive—the silent action reaches deeper than noisy intervention: the principle attends in my place.
process_zh: 设计静默通道：退出前台前，先建好不在场也能持续作用的结构（书面原则、定期仪式、可传阅的通信）——使'退'不等于'断'
预设干预判据：写明何种级别的事件必须打破静默（存亡级、原则级），以及以什么身份发声——把'例外'制度化以防失语或滥用
建立组织防火墙：静默影响不得经由组织利益传导——个人原则与机构立场分离，保证影响的纯洁性与可信度
克制执行：静默是常态，触发是例外——每次触发前后都对照预设判据复盘，防止'例外'膨胀为'新常态'
process_en: Design the silent channels: before leaving the front stage, build the structures that keep working in absence (written principles, periodic rites, circulate-able letters)—so 'withdrawal' is not 'severance'

Preset the intervention criteria: write down which order of event must break the silence (existential, principled) and in what capacity one speaks—institutionalize the 'exception' against both speechlessness and abuse

Build the organizational firewall: the silent influence must not travel through organizational interest—keep personal principle and institutional stance separate to preserve the influence's purity and credibility
Execute with restraint: silence is the norm, the trigger the exception—review each trigger against the preset criteria before and after, lest the 'exception' swell into a 'new normal'
representative_cases_zh: 四十年退隐的结构：数千通书信、每年四次达善、对世界局势的持续注视——静默影响通道的完整建制
1940 年致信支持盟军：以个人身份在文明存亡节点打破静默——干预例外的唯一档案化示范
修道院政治防火墙：坚拒国大党会议主席等公职请求、修道院与政治无涉——静默影响不被组织利益污染的制度保障
representative_cases_en: The forty-year withdrawal's structure: thousands of letters, four darshan days a year, a continuous watch on world affairs—the full apparatus of the silent channels
The 1940 letter in support of the Allies: breaking the silence, in a personal capacity, at a civilizational juncture—the sole archival demonstration of the intervention exception
The ashram's political firewall: refusing the Congress presidency and keeping the ashram apart from politics—the institutional safeguard keeping silent influence uncontaminated by organized interest
modern_applications_zh: 创始人/高管退居二线的影响力设计：书面原则与定期沟通为常态影响，'重大节点发声'预设判据并保持个人身份与公司立场分离——避免'垂帘听政'与'彻底失联'两个失败形态
公共知识分子的立场管理：以系统性著作为静默影响主体，把'就重大事件表态'留为有判据的例外——保护长期公信力
董事会与顾问的'不干预治理'：明确'何时必须发声'的触发清单（合规崩坏、存亡决策），其余时候以原则文件而非个人干预起作用
modern_applications_en: Influence design for founders and executives stepping back: written principles and periodic communication as the norm of influence, 'speaking at major junctures' preset with criteria and kept separate from corporate position—avoiding the twin failures of ruling from behind the curtain and total disappearance

Position management for public intellectuals: systematic writing as the main body of silent influence, leaving 'statement on major events' as a criterion-governed exception—protecting long-run credibility

Non-intervention governance for boards and advisors: an explicit trigger list of 'when one must speak' (compliance collapse, existential decisions); otherwise acting through principle documents, not personal intervention
related_modes: M-AUR-007（行动瑜伽伏藏法——同一'退出'工艺的两半：伏藏管旧事业，静默权变管退出后的作用）
M-WZT-010（武则天·无字碑留白法——近缘对照：武则天以碑之空白拒绝对身后发言，奥罗宾多以判据化例外保留发言权——'永久留白'与'按需发声'的两种收束）
M-LKY-006（李光耀·绝对条件坦白法——反向对照：李光耀以在场直言把条件讲透，奥罗宾多以静默与判据化发声管理同一影响力——直言在场与静默退场的对照）
M-AQU-006（阿奎那·类比言说控制法——远缘对照：阿奎那为不可言者立言说纪律（控制类比与沉默），奥罗宾多以静默为常态、判据化发声为例外——两种言与默的纪律）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行对照——卸任后以书信与原则持续影响共和国而拒绝对日常政治发言，'领袖不在场而原则在场'的政治版本

representative_figures.relation_zh: 反向对照——甘地以持续在场的非暴力动员干预政治，奥罗宾多批评其为'僵硬心智'并选择静默路线——'在场干预'与'静默作用'的正面对照

name_zh: 思想建构方法论/以'对话者带入的传统'为综合的原材料：与最重要的对手或传统深度对话（注释、对话体、通篇回应），把对方的强处吸收为自身结构的构件——'综合'不是外在折中而是内化对话
name_en: thought-construction methodology/take 'the traditions brought in by interlocutors' as the raw material of synthesis: converse deeply with the most important rival or tradition (commentary, dialogue form, whole-work response), absorbing the other's strengths as components of one's own structure—synthesis not as external compromise but internalized dialogue
category: 思想建构方法论/以'对话者带入的传统'为综合的原材料：与最重要的对手或传统深度对话（注释、对话体、通篇回应），把对方的强处吸收为自身结构的构件——'综合'不是外在折中而是内化对话
modes.domain_zh: 奥罗宾多的著作结构暴露了他的建构方法：《薄伽梵歌论》不是独立专著而是对提拉克与商羯罗两个权威注释传统的通篇回应；《神圣人生论》大量章节是对具体论敌（唯物主义、幻相论、不可知论）的逐一回应；《人类循环论》隐含与马克思主义、自由主义的全程对话。方法的结构：其一，选最强对话者——不与弱对手纠缠，注释传统与当代最强体系（商羯罗的不二论、达尔文主义、马克思主义）各自代表一个真实面向；其二，'回应即建构'——回应不是防御而是吸收：唯物主义的'实在性'被吸收为'神圣的物质性'，幻相论的'高'被吸收但不接受其'世界为幻'的代价；其三，对话者的强处成为自己结构的承重构件而非脚注——不二论的意识高度支撑他的层级地图，演化论的实感支撑他的双程结构。此法使他的体系成为'诸传统的最大公约吸收器'，也使阅读他的著作必须同时读他所回应者。代价与极限：'回应即建构'使文本高度依赖对话语境——抽掉论敌，著作结构失去骨架；且吸收不等于超越：某些被吸收的部分（如对唯物论的回应）在当代读者看来已被后来的科学论证绕过，对话的地基会随对话者的老化而老化。
modes.domain_en: The architecture of Aurobindo's works betrays his constructive method: Essays on the Gita is not a standalone treatise but a whole-length response to two authoritative commentarial traditions (Tilak's and Shankara's); The Life Divine answers, chapter by chapter, specific opponents (materialism, illusionism, agnosticism); The Human Cycle carries on an implicit全程 dialogue with Marxism and liberalism. The method's structure: choose the strongest interlocutors—never entangle with weak opponents; the commentarial traditions and the strongest contemporary systems (Shankara's non-dualism, Darwinism, Marxism) each represent a real facet. Response as construction—the response is not defense but absorption: materialism's 'realism' is absorbed as 'the divinity of matter,' illusionism's 'height' is absorbed without accepting its price of 'the world as illusion.' The interlocutor's strengths become load-bearing members of one's own structure, not footnotes—the non-dualist height of consciousness buttresses his layer map, the felt reality of evolution buttresses his double pass. This makes his system the maximal common-denominator absorber of the traditions, and makes reading his works inseparable from reading those he answers. Costs and limits: 'response as construction' makes the texts depend on dialogical context—remove the opponents and the architecture loses its skeleton; and absorption is not transcendence: some absorbed parts (the reply to materialism, say) have since been bypassed by later scientific argument, so the dialogical foundations age with the interlocutors.
modes.definition_zh: 思想建构方法论/与最强对话者全程深度对话并把其强处吸收为自身结构的承重构件——回应即建构，综合是内化对话而非外在折中
modes.definition_en: Thought-construction methodology/converse whole-length with the strongest interlocutors and absorb their strengths as load-bearing members of one's own structure—response as construction, synthesis as internalized dialogue rather than external compromise
modes.source_chapter: 《薄伽梵歌论》对提拉克与商羯罗注释传统的通篇回应；《神圣人生论》对唯物论、幻相论、不可知论的逐章回应；《人类循环论》对马克思主义与自由主义的对话结构
key_concepts: 最强对话者 the strongest interlocutors（不与弱手纠缠的选敌原则）
回应即建构 response as construction（回应是吸收而非防御）
承重构件 load-bearing absorption（对方的强处进入自己结构的骨架而非脚注）
最大公约吸收器 the maximal absorber（体系作为诸传统的综合容器）
对话地基的老化 the aging of dialogical foundations（对话者过时则回应结构随之过时）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我要回答的不是论敌，是传统——回答商羯罗时我在建我的楼：他的高度正是我的地基。
modes.key_quote_en: What I answer is not an opponent but a tradition—answering Shankara I build my house: his height is my very foundation.
process_zh: 选定最强对话者：为自己要建的每个结构单元各找一位代表该面向最强传统的对话者——拒绝与弱手纠缠
通篇回应而非脚注引用：以对话者的问题结构组织自己的文本（注释、逐章回应、对话体）——把对话置入承重位置
执行吸收式回应：逐项判定对方的'真面向'与'代价'——吸收其面向、拒绝其代价（如吸收唯物论的实在感而拒绝其意识取消）
检验承重：抽掉对话者检验自己的结构是否仍立——若某构件完全依赖对方存在，需为其找内在根据以防地基老化
process_en: Select the strongest interlocutors: for each structural unit to be built, find the interlocutor representing the strongest tradition of that facet—never entangle with weak hands

Respond whole-length, not in footnotes: organize one's text by the interlocutor's problem structure (commentary, chapter-by-chapter response, dialogue form)—place the dialogue in load-bearing position

Run absorptive responses: judge each item of the other's 'true facet' and 'price'—absorb the facet, refuse the price (taking materialism's felt realism while refusing its cancellation of consciousness)
Test the load-bearing: remove the interlocutor and see whether one's structure still stands—any member wholly dependent on the other needs internal grounding against the aging of foundations
representative_cases_zh: 《薄伽梵歌论》的双传统回应：对提拉克'行动瑜伽优先'与商羯罗'知识优先'两极的全程吸收式回应——'有为而无执'的综合在对话中生成
《神圣人生论》对幻相论的处理：吸收其意识高度、拒绝'世界为幻'的代价——吸收式回应的教科书操作
《人类循环论》与马克思主义的隐性全程对话：吸收其历史过程感、替换其经济还原论基础——不点名而结构性的对话
representative_cases_en: The dual-tradition response of Essays on the Gita: a whole-length absorptive reply to Tilak's priority of action and Shankara's priority of knowledge—'work without clinging' generated inside the dialogue
The treatment of illusionism in The Life Divine: absorbing its height of consciousness while refusing the price of 'world as illusion'—the textbook operation of absorptive response
The implicit whole-length dialogue with Marxism in The Human Cycle: absorbing its sense of historical process while replacing its economic-reductionist base—a structural, unnamed dialogue
modern_applications_zh: 立场文件的对话式写作：重要的方法论立场不以'独白+脚注'写，而以'对最强对立传统的逐节回应'组织——使立场在对话中获得承重结构
竞争分析的高标准：只与最强竞品对话（选敌原则），并把其真实优点写进自己方案的结构而非只写差异——防止'竞品分析'沦为贬低性对照
跨学科综述的建构式写法：让被综述的各传统承担自己论证的承重角色（如以某学科的强方法支撑自己的关键步骤），检验'抽掉任一传统结构是否仍立'
modern_applications_en: Dialogical writing of position papers: compose major methodological positions not as 'monologue plus footnotes' but as section-by-section responses to the strongest opposing tradition—giving the position a load-bearing structure inside the dialogue

A higher standard for competitive analysis: dialogue only with the strongest rival (the selection principle), and write the rival's real strengths into the structure of one's own plan, not merely the differences—keeping 'competitive analysis' from degenerating into derogatory contrast

Constructive writing of interdisciplinary reviews: let the reviewed traditions carry load in one's own argument (a discipline's strong method supporting a key step), testing 'does the structure still stand if any one tradition is removed'
related_modes: M-AUR-004（整体统摄法——对话综合是统摄在文本操作层面的执行工艺）
M-SHA-004（商羯罗·立敌对论法——最强对照：商羯罗立最强敌论以显自宗、回应也是显宗手段，奥罗宾多的回应同时是吸收与建构——'显宗'与'建构'两种回应取向）
M-HEG-001（黑格尔·辩证扬弃三段法——近缘对照：黑格尔同样以哲学史为自身结构的承重构件（体系的每一次升层都消化一个传统），但消化机制是矛盾逻辑；奥罗宾多的机制是面向吸收——两种'以对话建楼'）
M-CC-021（朱熹与阿奎那对照组·格物穷理渐进法——跨域对照：同为以累积性工作通达整体真理的建构，格物穷理以注疏渐进，对话综合以论敌回应渐进——两种'渐进建楼'）

name_zh: 事业收束方法论/把个体事业收束进超越个体的整体建制：个人修行最终指向'人类统一'——以制度实验（修道院、奥罗维尔）、文本遗产与传承结构使体系脱离创始人续存，个体退场即整体接管
name_en: enterprise-closure methodology/close the individual enterprise into a whole-institution transcending the person: personal practice points finally to 'human unity'—institutional experiments (the ashram, Auroville), textual legacy and transmission structures let the system outlive its founder, the individual's exit being the whole's takeover
category: 事业收束方法论/把个体事业收束进超越个体的整体建制：个人修行最终指向'人类统一'——以制度实验（修道院、奥罗维尔）、文本遗产与传承结构使体系脱离创始人续存，个体退场即整体接管
modes.domain_zh: 奥罗宾多事业的最终指向不是个人成就而是《人类统一的理想》所立法的目标——这个收束设计有三层。其一，目标层的收束：个体转化（三重转化）不是终点而是'人类统一'的前提构件——'个体完满与整体统一是同一件事的两面'，个人修行被预先编入世界性目标，事业因此天然超越个人。其二，制度层的收束：修道院（1926 起）与奥罗维尔（1968，由'母亲'主持落成，联合国教科文组织背书）是两个'去个人化'的建制实验——奥罗维尔宪章明确'不属于任何人'，把'人类统一'从理念降入可居住的城市形态。其三，传承层的收束：文本（约三十卷全集）、续传者（母亲的《议程》、萨特普姆的记录）、每年达善的仪式结构——体系在创始人身后以多载体续存，与龙树的'传承网络'同构。此法与 M-AUR-007/008 构成完整的退出三部曲：伏藏（旧事业封存）—静默（退场中持续作用）—收束（一切归于超越个体的建制）。代价与极限：'人类统一'作为目标不可证伪且时间尺度无限，使收束建制容易悬浮为象征（奥罗维尔至今人口远小于设计图景）；去个人化建制仍高度依赖 charisma 的转化性存续（'母亲'的个人权威是奥罗维尔落成的实际条件）；且收束目标的宏大可能吞没个体的当下义务——收束与当下（M-AUR-002 的'当下完善仍是义务'）之间的张力贯穿整个传承史。
modes.domain_en: Aurobindo's enterprise points finally not at personal attainment but at the goal legislated in The Ideal of Human Unity—a closure designed in three layers. At the level of the goal: individual transformation (the triple transformation) is not the terminus but a precondition member of 'human unity'—'the perfection of the individual and the unity of the whole are two faces of one thing'; personal practice is pre-inscribed in a world-aim, so the enterprise naturally transcends the person. At the level of institution: the ashram (from 1926) and Auroville (inaugurated 1968 under the Mother, endorsed by UNESCO) are two de-personalized institutional experiments—Auroville's charter states it 'belongs to nobody,' descending 'human unity' from idea into an inhabitable urban form. At the level of transmission: the texts (some thirty collected volumes), the successors (the Mother's Agenda, Satprem's records), the ritual structure of yearly darshan—the system survives the founder in many carriers, isomorphic with Nagarjuna's transmission network. The method completes with M-AUR-007 and M-AUR-008 the full trilogy of exit: entrustment (sealing the old enterprise), silence (acting on through absence), closure (all returning to an institution beyond the person). Costs and limits: 'human unity' as a goal is unfalsifiable with an infinite timescale, so the closure institutions tend to float as symbols (Auroville's population remains far below its designed vision); the de-personalized institution still depends on the transformative survival of charisma (the Mother's personal authority was the actual condition of Auroville's founding); and the grandeur of the closing goal may swallow the individual's present obligations—the tension between closure and the present (M-AUR-002's 'perfection of the present remains a duty') runs through the whole history of the legacy.
modes.definition_zh: 事业收束方法论/把个人事业预先编入超越个体的整体目标（人类统一）与建制（修道院、奥罗维尔）——个体退场即整体接管，体系以多载体脱离创始人续存
modes.definition_en: Enterprise-closure methodology/pre-inscribe the personal enterprise into a whole-aim beyond the person (human unity) and its institutions (the ashram, Auroville)—the individual's exit is the whole's takeover, the system outliving its founder in many carriers
modes.source_chapter: 《人类统一的理想》全书；奥罗维尔宪章（'不属于任何人'）；《母亲的议程》对建制移交的记录；《神圣人生论》末章对'个体与整体'的收束表述
key_concepts: 人类统一 human unity（个体事业的世界性收束目标）
两面同一 two faces of one thing（个体完满与整体统一的同构）
去个人化建制 de-personalized institutions（修道院与奥罗维尔的'不属于任何人'设计）
多载体传承 multi-carrier transmission（文本—续传者—仪式的结构化续存）
退出三部曲 the exit trilogy（伏藏—静默—收束的完整工艺）
modes.key_quote_zh: 个人的完满与人类的统一是同一件事的两面——我的退场之处，正是整体接管之处。
modes.key_quote_en: The perfection of the individual and the unity of humanity are two faces of one thing—where I exit, the whole takes over.
process_zh: 把个人目标预先编入整体目标：定义'我的工作最终服务于什么超越个人的图景'，并论证个体完满与整体目标的同构——事业从设计上就大于个人
建设去个人化建制：把目标降入可运行的制度形态（社区、基金会、宪章），并显式写入'不属于任何人'条款
铺设多载体传承：文本、续传者、仪式三线并行，任何单一载体消失体系仍续存——传承结构做冗余设计
演练退场接管：让每个载体的运转都不以创始人在场为前提，定期检验'创始人缺席时系统是否正常'——退场即接管
process_en: Pre-inscribe the personal goal into the whole-aim: define 'what trans-personal vision my work finally serves' and argue the isomorphism of individual perfection and the whole-aim—so the enterprise is larger than the person by design
Build de-personalized institutions: descend the aim into runnable institutional form (community, foundation, charter) with an explicit 'belongs to nobody' clause
Lay multi-carrier transmission: texts, successors and rites in parallel, so the system survives the loss of any single carrier—a redundant design for transmission
Rehearse exit-as-takeover: make each carrier's operation independent of the founder's presence and regularly test 'does the system run with the founder absent'—exit is takeover
representative_cases_zh: 《人类统一的理想》的立法：把个人修行预先编入'人类统一'的世界目标——事业在设计上大于个人
奥罗维尔（1968）的宪章设计：'不属于任何人'条款与去个人化的城市实验——收束目标的制度降入
身后多载体续存：三十卷全集、母亲《议程》、年度达善——创始人 1950 年离世而体系在修道院与奥罗维尔双建制中续存至今
representative_cases_en: The legislation of The Ideal of Human Unity: personal practice pre-inscribed in the world-aim of human unity—the enterprise larger than the person by design
The charter design of Auroville (1968): the 'belongs to nobody' clause and the de-personalized urban experiment—the institutional descent of the closing aim

Multi-carrier survival after death: some thirty collected volumes, the Mother's Agenda, yearly darshan—the founder dying in 1950 while the system continues in the twin institutions of ashram and Auroville to this day
modern_applications_zh: 开源/社区项目的收束设计：把项目目标编入超越创始人的公共目标并写入宪章（'属于社区'条款），以文档、维护者梯队、仪式（年度发布）三线做冗余传承
企业使命与创始人退场的配套：使命陈述必须先于退场与个人脱钩（收束立法），退场计划与'创始人缺席测试'制度化——防'创始人即公司'的组织病
家族财富与事业的代际收束：以宪章+受托结构+仪式三载体使事业脱离任何一代人，'个体退场即整体接管'作为家族宪法的收束条款
modern_applications_en: Closure design for open-source and community projects: inscribe the project's aim into a public goal beyond the founder, write the charter ('belongs to the community'), and build redundant transmission across docs, maintainer succession and rites (yearly releases)

Pairing corporate mission with founder exit: the mission statement must be decoupled from the person before any exit (closure legislation), with the exit plan and a 'founder-absence test' institutionalized—guarding against the pathology of 'the founder is the company'

Generational closure of family wealth and enterprise: charter, trustee structure and rites as three carriers freeing the enterprise from any single generation, with 'the individual's exit is the whole's takeover' as the closing clause of the family constitution
related_modes: M-AUR-007（行动瑜伽伏藏法——退出三部曲之一：收束承接伏藏交托出的旧事业）
M-AUR-008（静默权变法——退出三部曲之二：收束建制承接静默影响的通道）
M-NAG-010（龙树·感恩收束法——强平行：同以'体系不系于一人'为收束立法，龙树以传承网络、奥罗宾多以去个人化建制——两种'体系脱离创始人'的工艺）
M-JEF-001（杰斐逊·底层公理先行法——跨域对照：杰斐逊以成文宪法使共和国脱离本人，奥罗宾多以宪章与实验城使精神事业脱离本人——政治与灵性的平行收束工程）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—closed his life's work into 'human unity' and de-personalized institutions, exit as takeover
